title: Add CLAUDE.md with project conventions
description: No CLAUDE.md exists. Should document: build/test commands (uv sync, uv run transcribe), project structure, coding conventions, dependency policy (faster-whisper only), and any project-specific rules. This helps AI agents work effectively with the codebase.

title: Clean up stale merged branches
description: Two stale branches remain after merge: claude/readme and add-codeowners. Both are fully merged into develop. Local clone was checked out on claude/readme (now switched to develop). Clean up both local and remote branches. Also uses legacy claude/* branch naming convention.

title: Add error handling for model loading and transcription
description: No try/except anywhere in the CLI. Model download failures, corrupt audio files, disk-full on output-dir, and permission errors all produce raw tracebacks. Need: graceful error messages for model loading failure, audio file read errors, output directory write errors. Use sys.exit(1) with human-readable messages instead of tracebacks.

title: Add test suite for CLI and transcription logic
description: Zero test coverage. Need tests for: argument parsing, file-not-found error path, JSON output structure, multi-file batch behavior, output-dir creation. Use pytest. Can mock WhisperModel to avoid needing actual model downloads in CI.

title: Verify org-level webhook covers this repo
description: No repo-level webhooks configured. The org-level webhook (synodic-studio -> localhost:49374/hook) should cover this repo for auto-rebase on push to develop. Verify it works by checking Sentinel webhook server logs after a push. If org webhook doesn't cover it, add a repo-level hook.

title: Add CI/CD pipeline (Forgejo Actions)
description: No CI/CD exists. Need .forgejo/workflows/ci.yml with runs-on: self-hosted. Should run linting (ruff) and import check at minimum. Repo has no tests yet (separate bead), so CI can start with lint + build verification.

title: Update .gitignore with missing patterns
description: Missing from .gitignore: .DS_Store (macOS metadata, file exists on disk), .beads/*.db and .beads/.daemon* (beads local state). These are all local-only artifacts that should never be committed.

title: Fix model re-instantiation in batch transcription
description: WhisperModel is instantiated inside transcribe_file(), which is called per file. In batch mode (multiple files), the model is loaded from disk N times. Model loading is the most expensive operation (seconds per load). Fix: create model once in main() and pass it to transcribe_file(), or accept a pre-loaded model parameter.

title: Add ruff linter and formatter configuration
description: No linter or formatter is configured. pyproject.toml has no [tool.ruff] section. Add ruff config with reasonable defaults (line-length, target Python 3.12, standard rule sets). Add ruff format check. This is a prerequisite for meaningful CI.

title: Set repo description and topics on Forgejo
description: Repo has empty description and no topics on Forgejo. Set description to match pyproject.toml: 'Local audio transcription CLI using faster-whisper'. Add topics: python, cli, transcription, whisper, audio.

title: Add complete type annotations
description: main() is missing return type annotation (-> None). While transcribe_file has a return type hint (-> dict), it could be more specific (-> dict[str, Any] or a TypedDict). Add py.typed marker for downstream consumers. Consider adding ruff/mypy config to pyproject.toml to enforce type checking.

title: Pin faster-whisper dependency version
description: pyproject.toml uses loose version pin 'faster-whisper>=1.0.0'. While uv.lock pins the exact version (1.2.1), the pyproject.toml should use a tighter bound like '>=1.0.0,<2.0.0' or pin to '~=1.2' to prevent unexpected major version bumps on fresh installs.
